units: <cite ref="Megillah 6a:8">Meg. 6ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 33:19">Deut. XXXIII, 19</cite>) <he>חול זו ז׳ לבנה</he> ‘sand’ alludes to white glass.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 14b:5">Sabb. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>גזרו טומאה על כלי ז׳</he> declared glass vessels subject to the laws of levitical purity.
B. Kam. 30ᵃ זְכוּכִיּוֹתָיו his broken glass ware.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 30a:16">Ib.</cite> <he>זְכוּכִיּוֹתֵיהֶם</he> (<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 3:2">ib. III, 2</cite> sing.).
